description: Add a batchIndex property to procedures and middleware that indicates the position of each call within batched HTTP requests. This property should be undefined for non-batched requests, allowing developers to identify and handle individual calls within batch operations.
functional_requirements: Add a batchIndex property to procedure calls that shows the call's position (0, 1, 2, ...) within batched HTTP requests
Make batchIndex available to middleware so it can access the call position during request processing
Ensure batchIndex is undefined for all non-batched requests to maintain backward compatibility
Support batchIndex propagation through the entire request handling chain including adapters and links
Update type definitions to include batchIndex in relevant request and middleware interfaces
Add comprehensive tests covering batched, streamed, non-batched, and single-call scenarios
